dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Given your present countenance, one presumes you are missing some old friends again?

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: One cannot help but be reminded of them...

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Pray, speak. Unburden yourself of these sentiments.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: One simply wishes Menogias were alive to witness such peace alongside us.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: He was so skilled in matters of craftsmanship. Kite-making would scarcely prove to be a test of his capabilities. Were he yet amongst the living, he could have opened a kite stall. One is certain it would have been an establishment rich not only in profit but also esteem.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: And if, as in the past, he were unable to involve himself in matters of the mortal realm, we could sell the kites in his stead. When we finished, we could bring him back wine and partake in drink and good company...

dialogues.speaker: Jiehu
dialogues.text: Moon Carver. Those are now but fond moments in our memories.

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: ...Indeed. The dead are gone, so, as the representatives of the living...

dialogues.speaker: Houzhang
dialogues.text: Let us take in the sights for a bit longer, if just for his sake.
